core_claims: API exposes more than 100 planning and housing datasets through one interface
coordinate search requires latitude and longitude together
multiple dataset parameters may be supplied in one entity request
q supports postcode or UPRN search
entity responses can include name dataset start-date geometry and point
absence of results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies
geometry_entity uses another entity geometry for spatial filtering
geometry_relation supports within equals disjoint intersects touches contains covers coveredby overlaps and crosses
custom WKT geometries use WGS84 EPSG:4326 coordinates
offset and limit paginate entity results
response links can include next prev first and last URLs
the API has no portfolio batch endpoint
per-property portfolio calls should use polite rate limiting
bulk downloads include CSV JSON GeoJSON where applicable and Parquet
entity endpoint extensions include json html and geojson
typology is an array filter
organisation_entity filters by managing organisation
entity curie prefix and reference are array filters
period controls current or all entries
start-date components operate with a match mode
geometry_reference resolves geometries from entity references
geometry_curie resolves geometries from CURIE identifiers
field selection takes precedence over exclude_field
quality is an entity search filter and the API remains beta
